Reference length hint: Keep the clip short (5–15 seconds). Longer references make the encoder run out of VRAM and silently fall back to a default voice.
Verbatim transcript of the reference aud: Verbatim transcript of the reference audio
Tag voice enabled: Pick the voice from the tags in the reply
Tag syntax hint: A reply may open with a tag block: 小雅·女·妩媚·生气·：“你怎么才来！” — the tags choose the voice, only the text behind the colon is spoken.
Strip unknown tags: Also strip a tag block that matches no voice
Custom tags hint: Extra names that may be used as a tag. The folder names of the voice directory are added automatically.
Streaming hint: Start playing while the audio is still being generated. Much faster to hear, but the server cannot split the text by sentence.
Segment hint: The server synthesizes one sentence at a time, which gives better pauses but delays the first audio in streaming mode.
SegmentHint: The server synthesizes one sentence at a time, which gives better pauses but delays the first audio in streaming mode.
SegmentHintStreaming: Sentence splitting is switched off while streaming is on — a sentence has to be synthesized completely before any audio is pushed, which contradicts streaming. Turn streaming off to restore it.
Cache hint: Synthesized audio is stored on disk in the SillyTavern data folder. The same reply plays instantly the next time, even after a restart.
Cache stats: Cache statistics are not loaded yet.
Read range hint: Only the text between the two markers is read aloud. The outer characters are the markers, the text in between is just a label — 【朗读内容】 reads what is inside 【 and 】. Leave it on 朗读 to read the whole message.
Read range fallback: Read the whole message when the text has no range
ErrNoWebAudio: This browser does not support the Web Audio API.
ErrNoReferenceAudio: No reference audio selected. Upload a reference clip and add its transcript in the extension settings.
ErrNoReferenceText: The reference audio has no transcript. s2.cpp needs a verbatim transcript to clone a voice.
ErrNoSavedVoice: No voice selected. Pick a .s2voice or .wav voice in the extension settings.
WarnEncodeFailed: The reference audio could not be encoded, so the default voice was used instead. This usually happens when the reference clip is too long (5–15 seconds works best); check the s2.cpp log in the extension settings.
ErrReadVoices: Could not read the voice list: {msg}
ErrReadReference: Could not read the reference audio.
WarnNoMessage: There is nothing to read aloud.
SlashCommandHelp: Read text or the last reply aloud with a local s2.cpp voice.
LogNotRunning: s2.cpp was not started by this extension
CacheUnavailable: The server has no usable cache directory.
ErrS2Busy: s2.cpp is busy with another synthesis request. Please try again in a moment.
TagTreeMissing: The voice directory was not found. Set it above first.
TagTreeEmpty: There are no classified voices yet. Create three folders (gender / personality / tone) and put one .s2voice or .wav into each (a .wav needs a .txt transcript next to it).
TagTestNoBlock: No tag block found. Format: name·gender·personality·tone·:line
TagTestNoVoice: No voice matches the tags {tags} — the default voice is used.
TagPreviewText: Hello, this is a preview of this voice.
TreeNoTranscriptHint: s2.cpp needs the word-by-word transcript of this recording to clone the voice.
TreeTranscriptPlaceholder: What is said in this recording
ErrVoiceNoTranscript: This recording has no transcript yet. Fill it in with the ✎ next to it before the voice can be cloned.
ProfileTranscript: Word-by-word transcript (what is said in the recording)
ProfileTooLong: Too long: more than 15 seconds tends to run out of VRAM, 5–15 seconds is the sweet spot.
ProfileTooShort: Too short: under 1 second does not carry enough voice to clone.
ProfileNoName: Please enter a name for the profile.
ProfileNoTranscript: Please enter the transcript — s2.cpp cannot store a profile without it.
ProfileNoEngine: The path of s2.exe, the model and the tokenizer are missing. Fill them in under “Service process” first.
Export hint: Export writes every path and option into a JSON file. Import it on another SillyTavern to move the whole configuration over.
SettingsExported: The settings were exported to a file.
SettingsImportBadFile: There are no settings in this file.
ErrPluginMissing: The server plugin is not loaded. Run `node plugins.js install https://github.com/liangzhongyuan804-design/SillyTavern-S2-TTS` in the SillyTavern folder, add `enableServerPlugins: true` to config.yaml and restart SillyTavern (server plugins need SillyTavern 1.19 or newer).
